clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away in south-central Ashenvale near Fallen Sky Lake, Silverwing Grove serves as the staging grounds for the Silverwing Sentinels. From this fortified hollow, night elf warriors muster Alliance forces to push back the Warsong Clan loggers tearing through the forest.

Hidden beneath the emerald canopy southwest of Silverwing Outpost, Silverwing Grove is a crucial military staging post for the Silverwing Sentinels. Rather than a tranquil woodland retreat, it functions as the operational heartbeat for the night elves' bitter territorial contest against the Horde's lumber operations in Warsong Gulch. High-ranking Alliance officers, provisions, and scouts gather here, organizing skirmishes and marshaling champions to defend ancient Ashenvale against orcish expansion.
